card.text: Explore Tarvos, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Cassini measured a 10.691-hour rotation period for Tarvos and a modest minimum equatorial elongation. This ellipsoid uses an assumed polar depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.08:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
